notes.title: Navigation Update
notes.notes:
Today we are pushing out an update to HEIST to help address the pain of finding your way through the levels.

We have seen and heard a lot of players getting turned around when making their way to the Loot or an Exit.
When you're on your last Smoke Pipe and trying to make a break for the exit, the last thing you want is to take a turn to no where and end up wasting and potentially ruining your run.

To help this, we have added a compass-like pointer to give a generalised direction towards the current & relevant goal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30950309/71eb754a663befe180f9d84e0fdbff5e761280a1.gif

The compass will only be visible when you open the Objective List (by holding [TAB] or the [Back] button on a controller). The pointer will also disappear when you've arrived at the objective.

We have also updated the 'Blueprints' in the Level Selection.
Now instead of just the Location name, you can see the Level layout, including the 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30950309/e3b3de8c4d1f4db35734db35b804c5bbf74c2e63.jpg

Happy Heisting!
~Atomizer Games

notes.title: Beta Update: 0.3.10.r11
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png

Hello Heisters!

Today we have pushed out an update to HEIST with a focus on the Gun Guards.
In later levels, from the Casino onwards, You'll encounter guards that won't hesitate to apply deadly force to protect their employer's establishments.

We have made improvements to these guards which include the following

Gun Guards will now properly track a moving player while aiming.
Refined the time between Gun Guards aiming their gun and shooting at the player.
Gun Guard will no longer shoot the player while being held up by the player using the 'Fake Gun' tool.

Additionally, we have made the following improvements:

Guards movement slowing by Players Tools now apply and remove from the guard properly if stacked
Fixed lights in the Country Club warehouse turning off incorrectly
Fixed some navmesh issues in the Country Club


That's all for now, but as always we'd love to hear from you!
You can leave any and all suggestions and thoughts in the General Forum And leave any bug reports in the Bug Forum.

'Til next time...
~Atomizer Games

notes.title: New Update and Holiday News!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png

Greetings!

As the year comes to a close, we wanted to get out one final update to the build and let you know of our plans for the Holiday season.

Here's what's been changed in build 0.3.9r1:

Tutorial

Bomb placement instruction clipping through geometry
Fixed the wrong ambience SFX set for the level


Shipping Yard

Fixed some Props floating
Fixed a bug where kicking open the Crate allowed you to leave hiding spots without pressing the interaction key


Country Club

Added an effect when Looting the Filing Cabinets and Boxes
Fixed Document storage boxes playing the wrong SFX when looting
Ensured Lootables will play opening animation
Fixed a bug where loading a checkpoint wouldn't reset the animation of opened Filing Cabinets and Boxes


General

Updated the Art for the Paused menu
Moving the mouse will now trigger a change in preferred input device
Fixed an issue where new players would have their texture quality setting set to quarter



As always, if you come across any issues, please let us know on the Bug Forums.
If you don't see the update immediately, try restarting Steam.

The next update will be in January once we get back into the swing of development.
We plan on bringing you the final design of the Country Club as well as get you all into a functional version of the Art Gallery ready for testing.

In the meantime, we recommend checking out Snortlepig's latest Community Challenge:
The Caffeinated Casino Caper.
This one is a doozy of challenge and not for the faint-hearted.

We wish everyone and Happy Heisting Holidays! And we'll see you all in the New Year!

Heist Twitter AtomizerTwitter Heist Website

notes.title: Beta Update 0.3.7 now live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png
Greetings!

The build we have been promising since PAX is now live, and just in time for the rest of the long weekend!

You'll now see the improved art in the Tutorial that was on show at PAX.
Those changes had caused a lot of art in the shipping yard to break, and fixing that has been the bulk of the work leading up to this build.

Additionally, we have also added a 'Bug Report' button in the Main Menu and Paused Menu respectively.
Clicking on this will load the Bug Forums within the steam client.

We are already underway for the next update, but details on that later!
